Burjon waale aasmaan ki qasam
Aur us din ki qasam jis ka waada diya gaya hai
Aur gawaah aur jis ki gawaahi di jaaegi us ki qasam
Ashaab-e-Ukhdood halaak kar diye gaye
Aag se bhari hui khandaqon waale
Jin mein aag bhare baithe hue the
Aur woh momineen ke saath jo sulook kar rahe the khud hi us ke gawaah bhi hain
Aur unhon ne un se sirf is baat ka badla liya hai ke woh Khuda-e-Azeez o Hameed par imaan laaye the
Woh Khuda jis ke ikhtiyaar mein aasmaan o zameen ka saara mulk hai aur woh har shai ka gawaah aur nigraan bhi hai
Beshak jin logon ne imaandaar mardon aur auraton ko sataaya aur phir tauba na ki un ke liye Jahannam ka azaab hai aur un ke liye jalne ka azaab bhi hai
Beshak jo log imaan le aaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye woh jannatein hain jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi, aur yeh bahut badi kaamyaabi hai
Beshak aap ke Parwardigar ki pakad bahut sakht hoti hai
Wahi paida karne waala aur dobaara eejaad karne waala hai
Wahi bahut bakhshne waala aur mohabbat karne waala hai
Woh Saahib-e-Arsh-e-Majeed hai
Jo chaahta hai kar sakta hai
Kya tumhaare paas lashkaron ki khabar aayi hai
Fir'aun aur qaum-e-Samood ki khabar
Magar kuffaar to sirf jhutlaane mein pade hue hain
Aur Allah un ko peechhe se ghere hue hai
Yaqeenan yeh buzurg o bartar Quran hai
Jo Lauh-e-Mahfooz mein mahfooz kiya gaya hai
